articles.title: The AI-powered future of care
articles.summary: AI won’t replace clinicians, but it can improve quality, increase access, and reshape the workforce, payments, and patient volumes. Today, AI can perform some 16 to 22 percent of US outpatient care.

articles.title: Convenience or discovery: Which mission will your store serve?
articles.summary: As AI reshapes how consumers browse, shop, and buy, retailers must choose a mission for every location—and commit to it.

articles.title: Billion-dollar beauty: The odds of scaling a breakout brand
articles.summary: Our new analysis reveals the odds of reaching $1 billion in sales—and how the paths to that milestone differ by category and ownership.

articles.title: Democratized superintelligence is coming: The world needs to get ready
articles.summary: Bret Taylor, Sierra cofounder and OpenAI chair, believes AI’s near-term cybersecurity risks are real but solvable, and its greater power lies in delivering the world’s best knowledge to everyone.

articles.title: The new growth mandate: A conversation with LinkedIn CMO Jessica Jensen
articles.summary: At Cannes Lions 2026, LinkedIn CMO Jessica Jensen and McKinsey senior partner Dianne Esber discussed what it takes to turn AI from experimentation into a catalyst for growth.
